engagements.Title: Global defense and aerospace manufacturer
engagements.Role: Enterprise ITSM Change Manager / Project Manager
engagements.Scale: 200,000+ users across 50+ countries and sites; 12 critical systems; 10,000+ endpoints on three continents; $10M+ IT operations portfolio
engagements.Problem: Two merged organizations running separate service platforms, with no single enterprise change framework and recurring P1/P2 outages across business-critical systems.
engagements.What I Owned: Global change management and the enterprise ITIL Change Management framework; 20+ readiness assessments and focus groups; governance of change and outage process standardization; weekly reporting to 10+ C-suite executives.
engagements.Outcome: P1/P2 outages down 20% within six months across 12 critical systems; 98% milestone adherence; 200,000+ users enabled under DoD and NIST compliance.
engagements.Team: 8+ direct reports; ~12 on the program team
engagements.Headline: One change framework for a merged defense platform
engagements.Narrative:
Two merged organizations were running separate service platforms with no shared change process, and P1 and P2 outages kept recurring across business-critical systems.

I built the enterprise ITIL change management framework for a FedRAMP ServiceNow deployment: twenty readiness assessments and focus groups, standardized change and outage procedures, and weekly governance reporting to more than ten C-suite executives. I led a team of eight, fully remote, across sites on three continents.
engagements.Result Label: P1/P2 outages across 12 critical systems in six months

engagements.Title: Regional telecommunications provider
engagements.Role: Program Manager (also Project Manager and Scrum Master)
engagements.Scale: 10,000+ customers served; $3M project portfolio; five cross-functional teams of 25+ members
engagements.Problem: Service outages in high-demand regions damaging retention, alongside weak portfolio throughput and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
engagements.What I Owned: Program accountability for both the TNI deployment and the SPM optimization, including project management and Scrum Master duties across the delivery teams.
engagements.Outcome: Service outages down 25% for 10,000+ customers; customer retention up 15%; project completion rates up 15%.
engagements.Headline: Fewer outages and faster delivery for a regional carrier
engagements.Narrative:
Service outages in high-demand regions were costing the carrier customers, and too many concurrent projects were competing for the same people.

I ran the program across two workstreams — a Telecommunications Network Inventory deployment and a Strategic Portfolio Management optimization — and served as project manager and Scrum Master for thirty people in five cross-functional teams. Customer retention rose 15% and project completion rates rose 15%.

engagements.Title: Global cybersecurity software company
engagements.Role: Global Program Manager, Cloud Security Program
engagements.Scale: $560M in annual recurring revenue across 1,900+ accounts in JPAC, EMEA and NAM; top 100 strategic accounts each above $5M ARR
engagements.Problem: No consistent view of commitments, progress and risk across three regions, leaving leadership without a reliable picture of the cloud security program.
engagements.What I Owned: Program and portfolio accountability for account commitments and progress; presale program plans for the top 100 strategic accounts; weekly metrics, dashboards and performance tracking; governance of week-over-week account updates.
engagements.Outcome: One consistent leadership view of commitments, progress and risk across three regions, with risk surfaced early enough to act on.
engagements.Team: 2 direct reports; cross-functional team of program, consulting and account specialists
engagements.Headline: One view of commitments across three regions
engagements.Narrative:
Leadership at a global cybersecurity software company had no consistent picture of commitments, progress and risk across its cloud security accounts in Asia-Pacific, EMEA and North America.

I own program and portfolio governance for the initiative: presale program plans for the top 100 strategic accounts, weekly metrics and dashboards, and a week-over-week update cadence that surfaces risk early enough to act on. I lead a team of two alongside consulting and account specialists.
engagements.Result Label: annual recurring revenue under program governance
